gen_risks.description: Inadequate data protection and privacy measures may compromise the security of personal data in the NPR and SR systems.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement robust data protection and privacy measures, including encryption, access controls, and regular security audits.

gen_risks.description: Insufficient communication and outreach efforts may lead to low enrollment rates, particularly among vulnerable populations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement effective communication and outreach strategies, including awareness campaigns, training, and support for vulnerable populations.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate institutional capacity and resources may hinder the effective implementation and management of the NPR and SR systems.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide training and capacity-building programs for staff, and ensure adequate resources and infrastructure are available to support the implementation and management of the NPR and SR systems.
gen_risks.evidence: Section 44, Project Management, Capacity Building, and Monitoring and Evaluation

gen_risks.description: Dependence on a single technology platform or vendor may create risks related to system maintenance, updates, and potential vendor lock-in.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a strategy for maintaining and updating the technology platform, and consider diversifying vendors to mitigate risks.
gen_risks.evidence: Section 80, Procurement risks and mitigation measures

gen_risks.description: Inadequate monitoring and evaluation of the project's performance may hinder the ability to track progress, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and implement a comprehensive monitoring and evaluation framework, including regular reporting and data analysis.

gen_risks.description: Climate-related shocks and disasters may impact the project's implementation and the livelihoods of vulnerable populations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop strategies to enhance the resilience of vulnerable populations, including climate-resilient infrastructure and social protection programs.
gen_risks.evidence: Section 3, Morocco has undergone several overlapping shocks in recent years, and climate change is projected to significantly impact future economic growth and shared prosperity.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate grievance redress mechanisms may lead to dissatisfaction and mistrust among beneficiaries and stakeholders.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish and communicate effective grievance redress mechanisms, including clear procedures and timelines for addressing complaints and concerns.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate financial management and oversight may lead to inefficiencies, mismanagement of funds, or corruption.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement robust financial management and oversight mechanisms, including regular audits, financial reporting, and monitoring.

gen_risks.description: Delays or changes in government policies or regulations may impact the project's implementation and effectiveness.
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage with government stakeholders to stay informed about policy and regulatory changes, and develop strategies to adapt to potential changes.

gen_risks.description: Inadequate environmental and social safeguards may lead to negative environmental and social impacts.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement environmental and social safeguards, including measures to minimize waste, reduce carbon footprint, and protect vulnerable populations.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risk is assessed as Substantial. Given the complex nature of the operation and the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the implementation of the National Population Register (NPR) and the Social Registry (SR), the Project Management Unit (PMU) will need to put considerable effort into ensuring better coordination to achieve the PDO. The national rollout and the improvement of the NPR and the SR will need strong stakeholder engagement, including citizens concerned by social protection programs who are often poor and vulnerable.
gt_risks.mitigation: The communication strategy will continue to inform all stakeholders involved in project implementation and will capitalize on lessons learned from the first Identity and Targeting for Social Protection project (P155198). The PMU envisions improving the grievance mechanism at local and national levels and establishing a system to promote citizen engagement and transparency. The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee is responsible for developing guidelines for the strategic policy for the envisaged reform and ensuring a link with the ongoing social protection reform. Technical work will also cover a process evaluation to identify challenges, propose remedies, and provide recommendations to enhance system implementation at central and local levels.
